notes.title: The Achievement Update is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi folks![/h2]

Here comes the [u]Achievement Update[/u]!

We've been requested that feature a few times and so we brought it to life 😊

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
There's currently [b]28 achievements[/b] for you to get in Anx!
[list]
[*] 16 achievements for clearing each Campaign level with the the 3 Highscores goals
[*] 3 achievements for reaching a specific wave in Endless Mode
[*] 9 achievements that requires you to do something very specific in the game
[/list]
[i]PS: If you're an Achievement hunter, you can see all Achievements icons in the Steam Store page bellow to get some hints on those [b]hidden [/b] achievements![/i]

[h1]Update Discount[/h1]
To celebrate this update, we scheduled a [h3][b]-20% discount[/b][/h3]
This exclusive deal will be on from 
[b]Jan 12, 7pm CEST (10am PST)[/b] to
[b]Jan 21, 7pm CEST (10am PST)[/b], don't miss it out! 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500450/Anx_Defense/

[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]
[i][h3]V1.4.0.4[/h3][/i]
Apart from achievements, we also fixed and tweaked a few things after some player's feedbacks. 
Here's the patchnotes:
[list]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[*] Added Achievements to the game
[h3]Tweaks[/h3]
[*] Added and tweaked a few Visual Ambiances to make them more coherent (lighting/colors schemes in game).
[*] Tweaked Farms related tooltips to make the clearer and more accurate.
[*] Reduced sassiness of the "Shortcuts" Popup's button text. (sorry @McQueeb 😭)
[*] Removed FPS counter. 
[i]PS: Steam provides its own FPS counter for those who would like to keep that feature. It can be found at Steam > Settings > In-Game.[/i]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*] Fixed a bug where the UI would get broken if a level was ended while holding a building.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could still send waves by hitting "Enter" after game Over or Won.
[*] Fixed a bug where Highscores would reset if set to zero.
[/list]

[h1]Shoutout to Kantal[/h1]
We really wanted to make a big shoutout to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kcollective]Kantal[/url].
This update would probably never have seen the light of day without him.
Thank you so much!

You can check his games here 😊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158770/1BIT_CASTLE/ 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1526870/Otherwar/


Thank you for reading,
And we wish you all a happy new year!

Liador & Nael

notes.title: ANX Defense Launches on Steam!
notes.notes:

[h1]💸 Launch Discount[/h1]
[h3]Don't miss out on the -20% Launch Discount![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500450/Anx_Defense/

Be part of the Nocteon journey if you're as intrigued as we are!😊

notes.title: Release Date Reveal!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello folks! [/h1]
Nathan (Artist, Dev, 1/2 of Nocteon) here 😊
After [b]6 months of development[/b], we can proudly announce the release date of our [b]very first game[/b]!
This project was key for us to prove to ourselves that we could deliver a game 

[h1]The date[/h1]
The game will release on ...
[h3][b]December 6th[/b]![/h3]
Central-Europe (CET): 5pm
West-Coast (PST): 10am
East-Coast (EST): 1pm
Russia (MSK): 9pm
China (CST): 2am
Japan (JST): 3am


Watch the [b]trailer[/b] to get hyped about ANX's release and save the date!

[previewyoutube=S7ZiXMCa6mQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Full version features[/h1]
We're really excited to announce the full release features! 
In the full version, you will be able to enjoy:
[list]
[*] the [b]Endless Mode[/b]
[*] the [b]full Campaign[/b]
[*] new [b]Buildings[/b] (Damage Amplifier, Slow, Harvester, ...)
[*] a [b]new Mana Condition Mechanic[/b] that makes Mana management much more intricate!
[/list]

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
Developing ANX has been a real pleasure as well as a very tough challenge. 
Being our first game, we needed to understand our capacity to deliver a full-featured game for our players.

[b]Thanks[/b] for your support and all of your feedbacks, they've been absolutely key for us to move forward and focus on what's important during development!

We hope to see you fighting for you Nexus in ANX very soon!

Nathan
Artist & Developer
from Nocteon Games


[b]Wishlist[/b] the game now to get notified when it launches!
